note: CC-AUG6-AUDITPASS F8 — the settings-truth manifest. Every RENDERED control maps to an entry here, and every entry names an observable effect plus the test that proves it. A switch with no effect test fails the build. `suppressed_by` exists because the Aug 6 audit's 'dead switches' were mostly NOT unwired — all 17 controls were connected. They were alive and overridden: extra attempts forced ON by Kid Mode, reminders forced OFF by Kid Mode. A control that a mode overrides must SAY SO here, and must render as overridden rather than as an ordinary toggle the player can move to no effect.

controls.effect: body.kid class; kid_filter applied to word selection; camera absent; Say It disabled; account entry points hidden
controls.suppressed_by: age_locked (under-cutoff device cannot switch it off without the parent gate)

controls.effect: state.rate 0.9 -> 0.55; server path sets playbackRate, native path maps via SpeechRate.avRate; same word's audio runs >= 1.25x longer
a missed word offers a second try
controls.was: kid — Kid Mode forced this ON via `s.extra_attempts || s.kid`, so the switch did nothing in Spell Jr. D8 (delegated to Claude, 2026-08-06): the preference is authoritative; Kid Mode now DEFAULTS it on instead of overriding it.

controls.suppressed_by: kid — Kid Mode suppresses the daily reminder (`remind && !kid`). DELIBERATE, but the row must render as suppressed in Kid Mode, not as a live toggle.

controls.effect: audio_boost gain node, 0.5-2.0; loopback RMS rises monotonically across slider positions
controls.caveat: the AudioContext is created lazily and only when a boost is requested (anti-fingerprinting). If unlock() has not run on a user gesture the context can be born suspended — the effect test must move the slider AFTER a gesture.

controls.effect: imported words replace the list instead of appending
controls.device_note: Avail::Native/Server — native_lang::available() is false in headless Chromium, so flipping the flag changes nothing a web test could see and the assertion would pass for the wrong reason. Owed a Maestro flow.
